description: Recent reviews of 1-5 businesses from Google Maps, Trustpilot or Tripadvisor: rating, title, text (first 600 characters), date, language and the owner's reply, plus rating stats and a monthly trend per business. Reviewer names, profiles and photos are never returned. Billed per review returned plus a run start fee.

google_location.description: Country or city used to find a Google business given by name (default "United States"), e.g. "London,England,United Kingdom".

language.description: Google review language code (default en), e.g. es, fr, de.

reviews_per_business.description: Reviews per business (default 20). businesses x reviews_per_business must be <= 100.

sort_by.description: Review order (default newest). lowest_rating works for Google only.

targets.description: 1-5 businesses, one per item: a Google Maps place URL, place_id:<id> (from find_local_businesses), "Business name, street, city", a Trustpilot URL or trustpilot:<domain>, or a Tripadvisor review page URL.

name: business_reviews
title: Recent reviews of businesses
